title: A failed load of lists shows "No lists yet." instead of an error
where: /admin/lists, when the lists query fails (from code, not seen)
what_happens: page.tsx reads only `data` from the query and falls back to `lists ?? []`, so a database error renders the normal empty state "No lists yet." There is no error.tsx under /admin. Not seen in a browser: I can't make production fail without changing anything.
who_hurts: An admin would believe their lists are gone and may re-create them and re-add numbers, making duplicates.
suggested_fix: Read `error` from the query and show a short "Couldn't load lists, try again" line (or throw to an /admin error.tsx). src/app/admin/lists/page.tsx:12-15 and :27. Same pattern on the detail page's members query (src/app/admin/lists/[id]/page.tsx:37-43), which would show "No numbers yet."
rule: general: empty and error states must differ
